      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding: 0 24px 8px;
      margin: 0 -24px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      justify-content: flex-start;
    }

    .category-pills::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    @media (min-width: 900px) {
      .category-pills {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: center;
        overflow-x: visible;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 0;
      }
    }

    .category-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .category-pill:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      color: var(--white);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .category-pill svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; opacity: 0.7; }

    /* ============================================
       FEATURES / VALUE PROPOSITIONS
    ============================================ */
    .features {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--purple);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 42px);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 17px;
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .features-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .features-header .section-subtitle {
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .features-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .features-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px 24px;
      text-align: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
    }

    .feature-icon svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; }

    .feature-icon--green { background: rgba(85,218,155,0.12); color: var(--green-dark); }
    .feature-icon--coral { background: rgba(255,107,74,0.12); color: var(--coral); }
    .feature-icon--purple { background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1); color: var(--purple); }
    .feature-icon--yellow { background: rgba(255,216,77,0.15); color: var(--yellow-dark); }

    .feature-card h3 {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .feature-card p {
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ============================================
       STATS SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .stats {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--charcoal) 0%, var(--navy) 100%);
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .stats::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 800px;
      height: 200px;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(85,218,155,0.08), transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
    }

    .stat-item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .stat-number {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .stat-number--green { color: var(--green); }
    .stat-number--coral { color: var(--coral); }
    .stat-number--yellow { color: var(--yellow); }
    .stat-number--purple { color: var(--purple-light); }

    .stat-label {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .stat-star {
      color: var(--yellow);
      margin-left: 2px;
    }

    /* ============================================
       COURSES SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .courses {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--off-white);
    }

    .courses-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .course-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
    }

    .course-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .course-tab {
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .course-tab:hover {
      border-color: var(--gray-300);
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .course-tab.active {
      background: var(--black);
      border-color: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .course-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .course-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .course-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
    }

    .course-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .course-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .course-thumb {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-thumb-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 32px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .course-thumb-bg svg { width: 48px; height: 48px; opacity: 0.7; }

    .course-duration-badge {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .course-info { padding: 16px; }

    .course-info h3 {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--black);
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .course-instructor {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .course-students {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .course-students svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    /* ============================================
       CREATIVE FEED
    ============================================ */
    .creative-feed {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .creative-feed-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .feed-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .feed-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }

    .feed-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 36px 28px;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .feed-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 4px;
    }

    .feed-card--inspired::before { background: var(--coral); }
    .feed-card--connected::before { background: var(--green); }
    .feed-card--creating::before { background: var(--purple); }

    .feed-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .feed-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .feed-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

    .feed-icon--coral { background: rgba(255,107,74,0.12); color: var(--coral); }
    .feed-icon--green { background: rgba(85,218,155,0.12); color: var(--green-dark); }
    .feed-icon--purple { background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1); color: var(--purple); }

    .feed-card h3 {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .feed-card p {
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ============================================
       TEACHERS SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .teachers {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--off-white);
    }

    .teachers-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .teachers-header .section-subtitle {
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 640px;
    }

    .teachers-carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .teachers-carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .teachers-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .teacher-card {
      flex: 0 0 260px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .teacher-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .teacher-avatar {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 48px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .teacher-info {
      padding: 20px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .teacher-info h3 {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .teacher-info p {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .carousel-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--black);
    }

    .carousel-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    /* ============================================
       TESTIMONIALS
    ============================================ */
    .testimonials {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .testimonials-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px 28px;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .testimonial-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      color: var(--yellow);
    }

    .testimonial-stars svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    .testimonial-card blockquote {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .testimonial-name {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    /* ============================================
       TEAMS SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .teams {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--charcoal) 0%, #1E1E36 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teams::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      right: -200px;
      top: -100px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(86,32,193,0.12), transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .teams-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .teams-content .section-label { color: var(--green); }

    .teams-content .section-title { color: var(--white); }

    .teams-content p {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .btn-teams {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--black);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 14px 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-teams:hover {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(85,218,155,0.3);
    }

    .btn-teams svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    /* ============================================
       FAQ SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .faq {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .faq-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .faq-list {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .faq-item {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .faq-item:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }

    .faq-question {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 20px 0;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
      text-align: left;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
    }

    .faq-question:hover { color: var(--purple); }

    .faq-question:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--purple);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .faq-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .faq-icon svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      transition: transform var(--transition-base);
    }

    .faq-item.active .faq-icon {
      background: var(--purple);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .faq-item.active .faq-icon svg {
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }

    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .faq-answer-inner {
      padding: 0 0 20px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ============================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================ */
    .footer {
      background: var(--black);
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); }
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      padding: 4px 0;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .footer-col a:hover { color: var(--green); }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: row;
        justify-content: space-between;
        text-align: left;
      }
    }

    .footer-bottom p {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      max-width: 600px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .footer-logo {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--white);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .footer-logo .logo-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
    }

    .footer-logo .logo-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    /* ============================================
       UTILITIES / ANIMATIONS
    ============================================ */
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0,0,0,0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border-width: 0;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
      html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
    }

    .fade-in {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease;
    }

    .fade-in.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--purple);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
  </style>
</head>

  <!-- HEADER -->
  <header class="header" role="banner">

      <a href="#" class="logo" aria-label="CreativeHub home">
        <span class="logo-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <polygon points="12 2 15.09 8.26 22 9.27 17 14.14 18.18 21.02 12 17.77 5.82 21.02 7 14.14 2 9.27 8.91 8.26 12 2"/>
          </svg>
        </span>
        CreativeHub
      </a>
      <nav class="nav-links" aria-label="Main navigation">
        <a href="#">Browse</a>
        <a href="#courses">Courses</a>
        <a href="#teachers">Teachers</a>
        <a href="#teams">For Teams</a>
      </nav>
      <div class="nav-actions">
        <button class="btn-sign-in">Sign In</button>
        <button class="btn-signup-header">Get Started Free</button>
        <button class="mobile-menu-btn" aria-label="Open menu">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
            <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"/><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"/>
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="hero" id="hero">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="hero-content">

On CreativeHub, you\'ll find inspiration from hands-on classes and teachers at the top of their creative fields, so you can take the next step in your creative journey.' },

        { q: 'What can I learn?', a: 'CreativeHub has thousands of classes in everything from graphic design to cooking, productivity, filmmaking, content creation, UI/UX design, marketing, crafts, music, social media, and entrepreneurship. If it\'s something creative, you can learn it on CreativeHub.' },
        { q: 'What happens after my trial is over?', a: 'After your trial ends, your annual CreativeHub membership begins. You\'ll be billed for the year in full, so you can enjoy continuous access to creative classes year-round.' },
        { q: 'Can I teach on the platform?', a: 'Yes! CreativeHub teachers are everyday creatives and professionals who want to share their passion and the skills they\'ve gained with a community of eager learners. Visit our Help Center to learn more.' }
      ];

      /* ============================================
         RENDER COURSES
      ============================================ */
      var courseGrid = document.getElementById('courseGrid');

      function renderCourses(category) {
        var list = courses[category] || courses.featured;
        var html = '';
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          var c = list[i];
          html += '<div class="course-card fade-in visible">' +
            '<div class="course-thumb">' +
              '<div class="course-thumb-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg, ' + c.color + ', ' + adjustColor(c.color, -30) + ')">' +
                '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3"/></svg>' +
              '</div>' +

            '</div>' +
            '<div class="course-info">' +
              '<h3>' + c.title + '</h3>' +
              '<div class="course-meta">' +
                '<span class="course-instructor">' + c.instructor + '</span>' +
                '<span class="course-students"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/></svg> ' + c.students + '</span>' +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>';
        }
        courseGrid.innerHTML = html;
      }

      function adjustColor(hex, amount) {
        var num = parseInt(hex.replace('#', ''), 16);
        var r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num >> 16) + amount));
        var g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num >> 8) & 0x00FF) + amount));
        var b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num & 0x0000FF) + amount));
        return '#' + (0x1000000 + (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b).toString(16).slice(1);

      teacherCarousel.innerHTML = teacherHTML;

      /* ============================================
         TEACHER CAROUSEL NAV

      var prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
      var nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
      var scrollAmount = 284;

      var testimonialsGrid = document.getElementById('testimonialsGrid');
      var testHTML = '';
      var starSVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><polygon points="12 2 15.09 8.26 22 9.27 17 14.14 18.18 21.02 12 17.77 5.82 21.02 7 14.14 2 9.27 8.91 8.26 12 2"/></svg>';
      var fiveStars = starSVG + starSVG + starSVG + starSVG + starSVG;

      for (var i = 0; i < testimonials.length; i++) {
        var tm = testimonials[i];
        testHTML += '<div class="testimonial-card fade-in">' +
          '<div class="testimonial-stars">' + fiveStars + '</div>' +
          '<blockquote>\u201C' + tm.quote + '\u201D</blockquote>' +
          '<div class="testimonial-author">' +
            '<div class="testimonial-avatar" style="background:' + tm.color + '">' + tm.name.charAt(0) + '</div>' +
            '<span class="testimonial-name">' + tm.name + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }
      testimonialsGrid.innerHTML = testHTML;

      /* ============================================
         RENDER FAQ
      ============================================ */
      var faqList = document.getElementById('faqList');
      var faqHTML = '';

      for (var i = 0; i < faqItems.length; i++) {
        var f = faqItems[i];
        faqHTML += '<div class="faq-item">' +
          '<button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-' + i + '">' +
            '<span>' + f.q + '</span>' +
            '<span class="faq-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg></span>' +
          '</button>' +
          '<div class="faq-answer" id="faq-answer-' + i + '" role="region">' +
            '<div class="faq-answer-inner">' + f.a + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }
      faqList.innerHTML = faqHTML;

      /* ============================================
         FAQ ACCORDION
      ============================================ */
      faqList.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var btn = e.target.closest('.faq-question');
        if (!btn) return;

        var item = btn.closest('.faq-item');
        var answer = item.querySelector('.faq-answer');
        var isOpen = item.classList.contains('active');

        // Close all
        var allItems = faqList.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
        allItems.forEach(function(fi) {
          fi.classList.remove('active');
          fi.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          fi.querySelector('.faq-answer').style.maxHeight = '0';
        });

        if (!isOpen) {
          item.classList.add('active');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          answer.style.maxHeight = answer.scrollHeight + 'px';
        }
      });

      /* ============================================
         SCROLL ANIMATIONS (IntersectionObserver)
      ============================================ */
      var reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

      if (!reducedMotion) {
        var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
          entries.forEach(function(entry) {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
              entry.target.classList.add('visible');
              observer.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

        document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(function(el) {
          observer.observe(el);
        });
      } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(function(el) {
          el.classList.add('visible');
        });
      }
    })();

    .feature-card h3 {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .feature-card p {
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ============================================
       STATS SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .stats {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--charcoal) 0%, var(--navy) 100%);
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .stats::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 800px;
      height: 200px;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(85,218,155,0.08), transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
    }

    .stat-item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .stat-number {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .stat-number--green { color: var(--green); }
    .stat-number--coral { color: var(--coral); }
    .stat-number--yellow { color: var(--yellow); }
    .stat-number--purple { color: var(--purple-light); }

    .stat-label {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .stat-star {
      color: var(--yellow);
      margin-left: 2px;
    }

    /* ============================================
       COURSES SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .courses {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--off-white);
    }

    .courses-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .course-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
    }

    .course-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .course-tab {
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .course-tab:hover {
      border-color: var(--gray-300);
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .course-tab.active {
      background: var(--black);
      border-color: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .course-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .course-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .course-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
    }

    .course-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .course-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .course-thumb {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-thumb-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 32px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .course-thumb-bg svg { width: 48px; height: 48px; opacity: 0.7; }

    .course-duration-badge {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .course-info { padding: 16px; }

    .course-info h3 {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--black);
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .course-instructor {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .course-students {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .course-students svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    /* ============================================
       CREATIVE FEED
    ============================================ */
    .creative-feed {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .creative-feed-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .feed-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .feed-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }

    .feed-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 36px 28px;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .feed-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 4px;
    }

    .feed-card--inspired::before { background: var(--coral); }
    .feed-card--connected::before { background: var(--green); }
    .feed-card--creating::before { background: var(--purple); }

    .feed-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .feed-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .feed-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

    .feed-icon--coral { background: rgba(255,107,74,0.12); color: var(--coral); }
    .feed-icon--green { background: rgba(85,218,155,0.12); color: var(--green-dark); }
    .feed-icon--purple { background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1); color: var(--purple); }

    .feed-card h3 {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .feed-card p {
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ============================================
       TEACHERS SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .teachers {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--off-white);
    }

    .teachers-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .teachers-header .section-subtitle {
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 640px;
    }

    .teachers-carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .teachers-carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .teachers-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .teacher-card {
      flex: 0 0 260px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .teacher-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .teacher-avatar {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 48px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .teacher-info {
      padding: 20px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .teacher-info h3 {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .teacher-info p {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .carousel-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--black);
    }

    .carousel-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    /* ============================================
       TESTIMONIALS
    ============================================ */
    .testimonials {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .testimonials-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px 28px;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .testimonial-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      color: var(--yellow);
    }

    .testimonial-stars svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    .testimonial-card blockquote {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .testimonial-name {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    /* ============================================
       TEAMS SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .teams {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--charcoal) 0%, #1E1E36 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teams::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      right: -200px;
      top: -100px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(86,32,193,0.12), transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .teams-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .teams-content .section-label { color: var(--green); }

    .teams-content .section-title { color: var(--white); }

    .teams-content p {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .btn-teams {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--black);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 14px 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-teams:hover {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(85,218,155,0.3);
    }

    .btn-teams svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    /* ============================================
       FAQ SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .faq {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .faq-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .faq-list {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .faq-item {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .faq-item:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }

    .faq-question {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 20px 0;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
      text-align: left;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
    }

    .faq-question:hover { color: var(--purple); }

    .faq-question:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--purple);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .faq-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .faq-icon svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      transition: transform var(--transition-base);
    }

    .faq-item.active .faq-icon {
      background: var(--purple);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .faq-item.active .faq-icon svg {
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }

    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .faq-answer-inner {
      padding: 0 0 20px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ============================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================ */
    .footer {
      background: var(--black);
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); }
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      padding: 4px 0;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .footer-col a:hover { color: var(--green); }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: row;
        justify-content: space-between;
        text-align: left;
      }
    }

    .footer-bottom p {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      max-width: 600px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .footer-logo {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--white);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .footer-logo .logo-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
    }

    .footer-logo .logo-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    /* ============================================
       UTILITIES / ANIMATIONS
    ============================================ */
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0,0,0,0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border-width: 0;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
      html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
    }

    .fade-in {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease;
    }

    .fade-in.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--purple);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
  </style>
</head>

      function adjustColor(hex, amount) {
        var num = parseInt(hex.replace('#', ''), 16);
        var r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num >> 16) + amount));
        var g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num >> 8) & 0x00FF) + amount));
        var b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num & 0x0000FF) + amount));

            '<h3>' + t.name + '</h3>' +
            '<p>' + t.specialty + '</p>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }
      teacherCarousel.innerHTML = teacherHTML;

      /* ============================================
         TEACHER CAROUSEL NAV
      ============================================ */
      var prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
      var nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
      var scrollAmount = 284;

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {

      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        teacherCarousel.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });

      /* ============================================
         RENDER TESTIMONIALS
      ============================================ */
      var testimonialsGrid = document.getElementById('testimonialsGrid');
      var testHTML = '';
      var starSVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><polygon points="12 2 15.09 8.26 22 9.27 17 14.14 18.18 21.02 12 17.77 5.82 21.02 7 14.14 2 9.27 8.91 8.26 12 2"/></svg>';
      var fiveStars = starSVG + starSVG + starSVG + starSVG + starSVG;

      for (var i = 0; i < testimonials.length; i++) {
        var tm = testimonials[i];
        testHTML += '<div class="testimonial-card fade-in">' +
          '<div class="testimonial-stars">' + fiveStars + '</div>' +
          '<blockquote>\u201C' + tm.quote + '\u201D</blockquote>' +
          '<div class="testimonial-author">' +
            '<div class="testimonial-avatar" style="background:' + tm.color + '">' + tm.name.charAt(0) + '</div>' +
            '<span class="testimonial-name">' + tm.name + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }
      testimonialsGrid.innerHTML = testHTML;

      /* ============================================
         RENDER FAQ
      ============================================ */
      var faqList = document.getElementById('faqList');
      var faqHTML = '';

      for (var i = 0; i < faqItems.length; i++) {
        var f = faqItems[i];
        faqHTML += '<div class="faq-item">' +
          '<button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-' + i + '">' +
            '<span>' + f.q + '</span>' +
            '<span class="faq-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg></span>' +
          '</button>' +
          '<div class="faq-answer" id="faq-answer-' + i + '" role="region">' +
            '<div class="faq-answer-inner">' + f.a + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }
      faqList.innerHTML = faqHTML;

      /* ============================================
         FAQ ACCORDION
      ============================================ */
      faqList.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var btn = e.target.closest('.faq-question');
        if (!btn) return;

        var item = btn.closest('.faq-item');
        var answer = item.querySelector('.faq-answer');
        var isOpen = item.classList.contains('active');

        // Close all
        var allItems = faqList.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
        allItems.forEach(function(fi) {
          fi.classList.remove('active');
          fi.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          fi.querySelector('.faq-answer').style.maxHeight = '0';
        });

        if (!isOpen) {
          item.classList.add('active');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          answer.style.maxHeight = answer.scrollHeight + 'px';
        }
      });

      /* ============================================
         SCROLL ANIMATIONS (IntersectionObserver)
      ============================================ */
      var reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

      if (!reducedMotion) {
        var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
          entries.forEach(function(entry) {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
              entry.target.classList.add('visible');
              observer.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

        document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(function(el) {
          observer.observe(el);
        });
      } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(function(el) {
          el.classList.add('visible');
        });
      }
    })();
  </script>
</body>

      .course-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .course-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }

      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);

    .course-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .course-thumb {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
      overflow: hidden;

      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 32px;
      font-weight: 800;

    .course-duration-badge {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .course-info { padding: 16px; }

    .course-info h3 {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--black);
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .course-instructor {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .course-students {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .course-students svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    /* ============================================
       CREATIVE FEED
    ============================================ */
    .creative-feed {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .creative-feed-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .feed-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .feed-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }

    .feed-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 36px 28px;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .feed-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 4px;
    }

    .feed-card--inspired::before { background: var(--coral); }
    .feed-card--connected::before { background: var(--green); }
    .feed-card--creating::before { background: var(--purple); }

    .feed-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .feed-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .feed-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

    .feed-icon--coral { background: rgba(255,107,74,0.12); color: var(--coral); }
    .feed-icon--green { background: rgba(85,218,155,0.12); color: var(--green-dark); }
    .feed-icon--purple { background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1); color: var(--purple); }

    .feed-card h3 {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .feed-card p {
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ============================================
       TEACHERS SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .teachers {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--off-white);
    }

    .teachers-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .teachers-header .section-subtitle {
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 640px;
    }

    .teachers-carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .teachers-carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .teachers-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .teacher-card {
      flex: 0 0 260px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .teacher-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .teacher-avatar {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 48px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .teacher-info {
      padding: 20px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .teacher-info h3 {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .teacher-info p {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .carousel-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--black);
    }

    .carousel-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    /* ============================================
       TESTIMONIALS
    ============================================ */
    .testimonials {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .testimonials-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px 28px;
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .testimonial-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      color: var(--yellow);
    }

    .testimonial-stars svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    .testimonial-card blockquote {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .testimonial-name {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
    }

       TEAMS SECTION
    ============================================ */

      padding: 96px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--charcoal) 0%, #1E1E36 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teams::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      right: -200px;
      top: -100px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(86,32,193,0.12), transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .teams-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .teams-content .section-label { color: var(--green); }

    .teams-content .section-title { color: var(--white); }

    .teams-content p {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .btn-teams {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--black);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 14px 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-teams:hover {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(85,218,155,0.3);
    }

    .btn-teams svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    /* ============================================
       FAQ SECTION
    ============================================ */
    .faq {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .faq-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .faq-list {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .faq-item {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .faq-item:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }

    .faq-question {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 20px 0;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
      text-align: left;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
    }

    .faq-question:hover { color: var(--purple); }

    .faq-question:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--purple);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .faq-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .faq-icon svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      transition: transform var(--transition-base);
    }

    .faq-item.active .faq-icon {
      background: var(--purple);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .faq-item.active .faq-icon svg {
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }

    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .faq-answer-inner {
      padding: 0 0 20px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ============================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================ */
    .footer {
      background: var(--black);
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); }
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      padding: 4px 0;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .footer-col a:hover { color: var(--green); }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: row;
        justify-content: space-between;
        text-align: left;
      }
    }

    .footer-bottom p {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      max-width: 600px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .footer-logo {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--white);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .footer-logo .logo-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
    }

    .footer-logo .logo-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    /* ============================================
       UTILITIES / ANIMATIONS
    ============================================ */
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0,0,0,0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border-width: 0;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
      html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
    }

    .fade-in {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease;
    }

    .fade-in.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--purple);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
  </style>
</head>

            '<span class="testimonial-name">' + tm.name + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }
      testimonialsGrid.innerHTML = testHTML;

      /* ============================================
         RENDER FAQ
      ============================================ */
      var faqList = document.getElementById('faqList');
      var faqHTML = '';

      for (var i = 0; i < faqItems.length; i++) {
        var f = faqItems[i];
        faqHTML += '<div class="faq-item">' +
          '<button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-' + i + '">' +
            '<span>' + f.q + '</span>' +
            '<span class="faq-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg></span>' +
          '</button>' +
          '<div class="faq-answer" id="faq-answer-' + i + '" role="region">' +
            '<div class="faq-answer-inner">' + f.a + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }
      faqList.innerHTML = faqHTML;

      /* ============================================
         FAQ ACCORDION
      ============================================ */
      faqList.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var btn = e.target.closest('.faq-question');
        if (!btn) return;

        var item = btn.closest('.faq-item');
        var answer = item.querySelector('.faq-answer');
        var isOpen = item.classList.contains('active');

        // Close all
        var allItems = faqList.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
        allItems.forEach(function(fi) {
          fi.classList.remove('active');
          fi.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          fi.querySelector('.faq-answer').style.maxHeight = '0';
        });

        if (!isOpen) {
          item.classList.add('active');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          answer.style.maxHeight = answer.scrollHeight + 'px';
        }
      });

      /* ============================================
         SCROLL ANIMATIONS (IntersectionObserver)
      ============================================ */
      var reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

      if (!reducedMotion) {
        var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
          entries.forEach(function(entry) {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
              entry.target.classList.add('visible');
              observer.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

        document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(function(el) {
          observer.observe(el);
        });
      } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(function(el) {
          el.classList.add('visible');
        });
      }
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

steps.message:
The CreativeHub landing page is complete at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what was built:

**Design System:**
- **Typography:** Plus Jakarta Sans (800 weight headlines) + Inter (body) — bold geometric pairing
- **Colors:** Deep charcoal/navy hero (#1A1A2E, #0F0F14), green accent (#55DA9B), coral (#FF6B4A), purple (#5620C1), yellow (#FFD84D)
- **Style:** Modern flat with subtle gradients, rounded corners (12-16px), smooth hover animations

**All 10 Sections:**
1. **Header** — Fixed nav with logo, links, Sign In/Sign Up, mobile hamburger
2. **Hero** — Headline with accent colors, "7 free days" subtitle, Google + Email CTAs, legal text, 10 scrollable category pills
3. **Features** — 4-card grid (Thousands of Classes, Creative Pros, Learning Paths, Certificates) with colored icons
4. **Stats** — Dark contrast band with 425k+ / 30k+ / 9k+ / 4.8★ in large colored type
5. **Courses** — 15 category tabs with instant switching, 8 course cards (thumbnail, title, instructor, students, duration)
6. **Creative Feed** — 3 cards (Stay Inspired, Stay Connected, Keep Creating) with colored top borders
7. **Teachers** — Horizontal scrollable carousel with 8 teacher cards + prev/next buttons
8. **Testimonials** — 4-card grid with star ratings, quotes, and avatars
9. **Teams** — Dark section with CTA "Learn More"
10. **FAQ** — 5-item accordion (one open at a time) with animated expand/collapse
11. **Footer** — 9-column link grid + legal disclaimer

**Interactions:** FAQ accordion, course tab switching, teacher carousel scrolling — all working via vanilla JS.

**Accessibility:** aria-labels, aria-expanded, focus-visible styles, prefers-reduced-motion support, semantic roles, keyboard navigable. Fully responsive (375px → 1440px).
